derivation: Original join key for evaluation and scoring

description: Pickup zone in Addis Ababa (12 canonical zones)
derivation: Canonicalized from raw labels (mapped typos and casing to uppercase canonical list)

description: Hour start timestamp in East Africa Time (EAT UTC+3)
derivation: Parsed from mixed formats (ISO-8601 day-first dd/mm/yyyy and UTC+3 offset strings)

description: Target variable: ride requests in zone-hour (train only)
derivation: Ground truth ride demand; rows with negative or invalid values removed

description: Air temperature in degrees Celsius (0 NaNs)
derivation: Converted from UTC to EAT; Fahrenheit readings (>45 C) converted via (F-32)*5/9; missing hours resolved via continuous hourly grid time-series linear interpolation and ffill/bfill

description: Rainfall in mm during the preceding hour (0 NaNs)
derivation: Converted from UTC to EAT; negative sentinels (-9999.0) resolved; missing hours imputed via time-series interpolation with 0.0 mm dry default

description: Relative humidity percentage (0-100) (0 NaNs)
derivation: Converted from UTC to EAT; bounded to valid physical range [0 100]; missing hours resolved via time-series linear interpolation and ffill/bfill

description: Wind speed in km/h (0 NaNs)
derivation: Converted from UTC to EAT; bounded >= 0; missing hours resolved via time-series linear interpolation and ffill/bfill

description: Cumulative rolling 3-hour precipitation in mm
Precipitation intensity class (0=None 1=Light 2=Moderate 3=Heavy)

Binary flag indicating active event or proximity within 48 hours
derivation: Computed: 1.0 if active_window > 0 or hours_until > 0 or hours_since > 0

description: Binary flag indicating current hour is within event start to end
derivation: Interval join matching zone-hours where start <= pickup_hour <= end

description: Hours remaining until start of nearest upcoming event (horizon 48h)
derivation: Forward as-of merge between zone timestamp and upcoming confirmed event start

description: Hours elapsed since conclusion of nearest previous event (horizon 48h)
derivation: Backward as-of merge between zone timestamp and previous confirmed event end
